title: Common invariant measures for beta-transformations with rational affine relations
summary: We classify common invariant probabilities for two beta-transformations with a rational affine relation between their bases. Let $β>1$ be irrational and $γ=aβ+c>1$, where $a,c\in\mathbb Q$ and $a+c\ne1$. Every finite nonnegative measure that is singular with respect to Lebesgue measure and invariant under both maps is a multiple of the point mass at zero. No entropy, ergodicity or multiplicative independence assumption is needed.
